name: Data-Tel of Louisiana
description: Welcome to Data-Tel of Louisiana, Inc. (Data-Tel) where our business is “connecting your world”. Data-Tel is a corporation registered in the state of Louisiana and operates under Louisiana Contractor License #36386. We are also licensed in the states of Mississippi and Alabama. With a staff of over twenty employees, and an in-house Registered Communication Distribution Designer (RCDD), Data-Tel of Louisiana specializes in structured cabling systems, low voltage systems wiring, outside plant fiber optic and copper design and installation.

name: Depco Power Systems
description: Depco Power Systems distributes switchgear for defense, mining, telecommunications and oil & gas industries. Switchgear units meet military specifications and are used in power generation and standby applications.

name: Detroit Automotive Technologies
description: Founded in 2003, Detroit Automotive Technologies (DAT) is an award-winning MBE supplier of interior trim and acoustic systems to automotive OEMs. DAT is a technology-driven organization and customers choose DAT because of the intense commitment to providing quality components and systems that exceed industry standards.

name: Dextronix, Inc.
description: Dextronix creates affordable implantable medical devices for the exclusive use in veterinary medicine. The company’s initial focus was on the treatment of heart disease in dogs with permanent implantable pacemaker systems. Dextronix then also offers selected stent and catheter products to treat a variety of problems in cats and dogs. Since 2013 Dextronix expanded into wireless digital diagnostic monitoring equipment with focus on cardiology, airway management and urology.
